anniversarySections.title: The days we keep
anniversarySections.subtitle: A bright little archive of Julia and Suliaman, in photographs and motion.
anniversarySections.closingNote: Every frame still feels like us.

items.caption: A moment we wanted to keep.
The kind of ordinary that becomes precious.
A little joy, exactly where it belongs.
The glow of another day together.
A memory with its own kind of sunshine.
Still choosing the same side.
A face, a laugh, a whole story.
One more reason to be grateful.
A soft pause in our busy lives.
The brightness we bring into the room.
A memory worth returning to.
Two people, one growing story.
A day that stayed with us.
The quiet magic of being known.
Another page in our favorite story.
A bright memory from Julia and Suliaman.
The little details are the big things.
A moving memory we can visit again.
A laugh that refuses to stay still.
A few seconds of our forever.
The story continues in motion.
A small scene with a big feeling.
Joy looks good on us.
Another moment to replay.
Us, exactly as we are.
